subject: Request: Field coverage gap — Q3 banded offer plan & headcount request
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Morales <sara@brightedge.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Field coverage gap — Q3 banded offer plan & headcount request

Team —

We have an urgent coverage gap in west enterprise (SF + Bay Area) following two recent attritions. Intake demand for Q3 is strong from existing pipeline (see SL3 opportunities in the shared Drive), and I want to request a fast-follow headcount approval so we can convert two AE requisitions and one Solutions Engineer to hiring priorites. High level ask: 2 Enterprise AEs (mid seniority) + 1 SE (pre-sales, 65% quota-attached).

Attached is a lightweight request workbook with the proposed cost impact and a proposed banded offer matrix (Q3_offer_bands_v2.pdf). Quick bullets:
- Proposed comp bands (total OTE): AE band A: 160–190k, AE band B: 140–165k, SE band: 130–155k
- Target start window: mid-July to early Aug (staggered to align with ramp cohorts)
- Total incremental run-rate at midpoint: ~ $1.08M annualized (headcount + hiring/OTE catchup)
- Hiring priority: P1 for AE#1 (covers high-ACV region), P2 for SE, P3 for AE#2

Requesting:
1) Quick nod from finance on cost center and runway (Laura)
2) Confirmation from Sales Ops that these bands align to quota and comp structure (Ben)
3) Agreement on prioritization and preferred interview loop (Marissa & Jonas)

Sara (BrightEdge) — I’ve looped you for immediate candidate outreach; please flag available shortlist timelines.

If we can get approvals by EOD Friday (6/11) Recruiting can open roles and start outreach next week.

Thanks,
Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Director, West Field Sales
Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sara Morales <sara@brightedge.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Field coverage gap — Q3 banded offer plan & headcount request

Thanks Priyom — good summary. A few quick responses:

- I support moving AE#1 to P1 immediately. That role should have a slightly elevated signing buffer given market. Recommend midpoint + 7% signing authority to close quickly.
- For the SE role, please confirm target technical interviewers (I propose Kyle from Solutions + one platform PM). 
- AE#2: prefer to hold until we see AE#1 pipeline conversion at 30/60 days, but happy to open if recruiting bandwidth allows.

I attached informal notes to the offer bands and a suggested interview loop. If Ben can confirm the comp buckets land cleanly in the comp plan and Laura can confirm runway, I can sign off and we can publish to Recruiting.

On candidate sourcing: Sara — if you can prioritize Bay Area-heavy pools and provide 8–10 screens in the next 10 business days, that would be ideal.

On timeline: if we open roles by 6/14 and run two-week high-intensity sourcing + interview loops, earliest start for AE#1 is 7/20.

-Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Field coverage gap — Q3 banded offer plan & headcount request

Looping in a few specifics from Sales Ops/Finance view:

- Cost center: 300-44-02 (West Field Sales) — Laura, please confirm but that’s the expected charge.
- Comp bands reviewed vs current pay market: AE band midpoints are OK; we should set AE#1 target OTE at 175k and leave a 6% negotiable signing allowance. SE band midpoint 143k recommended.
- Headcount pipeline: Recruiting capacity is tight next week; Sara, confirm that your team can commit to 8–12 active candidates per role, otherwise we’ll push AE#2 to July open.
- Hiring request ID created: HR-HR-2027-675 (placeholder) — Laura, please turn this into a formal req in Workday if you approve.

Attachments: I added a quick cost-first-year sheet to the workbook (see Q3_field_gap_headcount_request.xlsx).

Ben

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Field coverage gap — Q3 banded offer plan & headcount request

Thanks everyone — consolidating approvals and next steps below: 

1) Laura: please convert HR-HR-2027-675 into a formal Workday req on cost center 300-44-02 (Ben confirmed). If you run into runway constraints, flag immediately.
2) Ben: confirmed comp band midpoints (AE 175k target, SE 143k). Approve 6% signing allowance for AE#1.
3) Marissa: interview loop approved (Kyle + PM + hiring panel). AE#2 held to contingent open; we’ll re-evaluate after 30 days.
4) Sara: please provide preliminary shortlist (x8) by 6/18 and confirm commitment to 10 active screens per role.

I’ve attached the finalized band PDF and the updated workbook with Ben’s cost sheet. Recruiting will open AE#1 + SE requisitions Monday if Workday req is live.

If there are any blockers, please call/text — otherwise I’ll mark this P1 and ask recruiting to proceed.

Best,
Priyom
